summary: Iteration 5 validated migration Checkout Pro → MP Preapproval (recorrente). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (test_preapproval.py) covering preapproval creation, reuse, GET /api/subscription (401 unauth / free defaults / after-checkout), cancel (404 no preapproval / OK after checkout), webhook HMAC (invalid=401, missing=401, valid signed=200), 3-day grace (within=premium, beyond=free), and regression (admin stats/settings/password_gen). Frontend: /premium shows 'R$ 9,90/mês' (after aligning DB setting to 9.90) and fineprint 'Assinatura mensal recorrente'. Clicking premium-subscribe-button navigates to https://www.mercadopago.com.br/subscriptions/checkout?preapproval_id=... (verified via network request interception). Manual admin-promoted premium user (no authorized preapproval) shows disabled 'Assinatura ativa' (premium-active-button) — cancel button NOT rendered as required. AdBanner hidden for premium on Home. Admin panel regression OK (stats + sliders + user list render). Admin left as FREE.

ui_bugs.issue: Seed DEFAULT_SETTINGS.premium_price_brl=19.90 conflicts with .env PREMIUM_PRICE_BRL=9.90 → UI shows R$19,90 while MP charges R$9,90. Testing agent updated DB to 9.90 via /api/admin/settings.

issues: Copy still says 'Valor cobrado para 30 dias de acesso.' — should reflect monthly recurring subscription (e.g., 'Valor cobrado mensalmente (assinatura recorrente)').

action_items: Align DEFAULT_SETTINGS.premium_price_brl in backend/server.py with PREMIUM_PRICE_BRL env (or seed from env on startup) so freshly seeded environments don't display R$19,90 while MP is billed R$9,90.
Update admin panel copy for 'Preço do Premium' from '30 dias de acesso' to 'mensalmente / assinatura recorrente' to match the new preapproval model.
Optional: in checkout_premium, when reusing an existing pending preapproval whose amount/reason drifted from current settings, consider recreating instead of reusing (edge case).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L106-108: is_premium grace logic adds 3d only when plan=='premium' AND preapproval_status=='authorized'. Users with plan=='canceled' + authorized won't get grace — intentional (canceled = user opted out) but worth documenting.

server.py L367: valid_mp_signature returns True when MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty. Fine for local dev, but consider hard-failing on startup in production if PUBLIC_BASE_URL is set but MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not.
server.py L488-491: fallback retry with 'canceled' (single L) after 'cancelled' — good, but the second try uses same SDK client that may have already logged an error. Not a bug, just noise.

server.py L397: mercadopago_webhook returns {received: False} when mp_sdk is None (bypassing signature check). Acceptable for dev, but in prod should still 401 if signature is invalid regardless of mp_sdk.
extend_premium_one_cycle uses processed_mp_events with _id=payment_id as idempotency key — good; ensure the _id unique index is guaranteed by MongoDB default on _id (it is).
Frontend App.js: getUser() reads localStorage synchronously, so admin plan changes require re-login for current user (pre-existing limitation).
test_credentials: admin@facilita.ai / Facilita@123. Transient uitest_pre_* + TEST_pre_* users created and left as free (some orphaned pending preapprovals in MP sandbox, no impact).
seed_data_creation: premium_price_brl updated in DB from 19.90 → 9.90 via /api/admin/settings to match .env PREMIUM_PRICE_BRL. Admin left FREE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET is now set (cdf0aaf864...). Webhook signature validation is enforced: manifest = f'id:{data_id.lower()};request-id:{request_id};ts:{ts};' HMAC-SHA256 → hex(v1). ts is seconds (or ms, both accepted, ±5min window). Preapproval endpoint returns init_point='https://www.mercadopago.com.br/subscriptions/checkout?preapproval_id=...'. Re-calling POST /api/checkout/premium for the same user with existing pending preapproval returns the same preapproval_id (reuse). GET/POST /api/subscription and /api/subscription/cancel are the new endpoints; /api/payments/{id} is REMOVED. is_premium applies +3d grace ONLY when subscription.plan=='premium' AND preapproval_status=='authorized'. To simulate an authorized invoice webhook without real card, generate x-signature with the HMAC helper in test_preapproval.py::_sign.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regressions. Minor mismatch: DEFAULT_SETTINGS.premium_price_brl (19.90) not synced with PREMIUM_PRICE_BRL env (9.90) → UI/backend price display drift. Fix: seed price from env or update DEFAULT_SETTINGS default to 9.90.
